title: SonicWALL Connect Tunnel Link Following Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of SonicWALL Connect Tunnel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SonicWall VPN. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the application to create a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a persistent denial-of-service condition on the host system.
